 The Detroit Pistons travel to Xfinity Mobile Arena on Sunday, October 25, to face the Philadelphia 76ers in an early-season Eastern Conference showdown between two undefeated teams.

 How to Watch Pistons vs 76ers
 When: Sunday, October 25, 2026
 Time: 7:30 PM ET
 TV Channel: NBC Sports Philadelphia, The Spot – Grand Rapids 17
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Detroit has opened the 2026-27 NBA season with consecutive impressive victories, defeating the Boston Celtics 121-113 before cruising past the Miami Heat 128-111 on Friday. Cade Cunningham continues to lead a talented Pistons roster looking to build on last season’s success, while Jalen Duren provides a strong interior presence on both ends of the floor. Detroit has averaged 124.5 points through its first two games, showing the offensive firepower that could make the Pistons a serious contender in the Eastern Conference.
 Philadelphia has also enjoyed a perfect start, securing victories over the New York Knicks and Cleveland Cavaliers to improve to 2-0. Tyrese Maxey has been instrumental in the 76ers’ early success, while Joel Embiid remains a major factor when healthy. Philadelphia will look to maintain its unbeaten record in front of its home crowd, but slowing down Cunningham and a Detroit offense firing on all cylinders will be a difficult challenge. With both teams entering Sunday’s contest undefeated, this matchup offers an early test for two teams hoping to compete near the top of the Eastern Conference.
